brief:
Israeli forces conducted an airstrike Saturday targeting a motorcycle in the Tal al-Hawa residential district south of Gaza City, killing two civilians and wounding additional people, Shehab Wire reported. The strike marked the latest in a series of aerial operations by Israeli military forces over the densely populated enclave.

The attack struck the vehicle in the neighborhood as fighting continued across the Gaza Strip. Tal al-Hawa, located in the southern portion of Gaza City, has experienced repeated military operations during the ongoing conflict.
